claim: N=128 seed 23 (m2 fixed at 0.5, data_seed 1) reached a final layer-1 trained force R2 of 0.81915 at step 24000 (control 0.63336, margin 0.186), which is 0.028 below the N=64 value of 0.8467. The trained R2 at step 12000, read as the layer-1 control plus the 0.178 margin, was 0.811, so the run gained only 0.008 from step 12000 to 24000. Force sat flat at 0.811-0.814 from step 9000 to 17000 and then rose by about 0.005 during the low-lr tail. Final accel_step R2 is 0.94462 at layer 3 against control 0.75933 (margin 0.185). On the headroom-normalised margin, accel_step leads force, 0.770 vs 0.507.
confidence_note: The run completed all 24000 of 24000 planned steps. Force stayed at layer 1 at every checkpoint, so every comparison here is same-layer. It also passed the horizon check: 0.811 at step 12000 is within 0.004 of the 12000-step run's 0.8150. The result falls between the two prediction bands. The 'true' band needed a final R2 of at least 0.827 and a gain of at least 0.01; the run got 0.819 and 0.008. The 'false' band needed a final R2 of at most 0.807, or a gain of at most 0.005 with a gap of at least 0.03; the run's gap is 0.028. accel_step's normalised margin of 0.770 falls inside the expected [0.60, 0.85]. Over steps 12000-24000 val_mse_ratio fell about one decade (0.0433 to 0.0041), but force gained only about 0.008 per decade. In the seed-21 rerun arm over the same steps, force gained 0.032 (0.754 to 0.786). So seed 23 looks close to levelling off about 0.02-0.03 below N=64 rather than closing the gap. That reading rests on one seed and gaps of 0.005-0.01, about the size of within-run checkpoint noise. A layer-1 force R2 of 0.827 or more in a longer or replicate run would move this toward supported. Several more seeds levelling off at 0.025-0.04 below their N=64 values would move it toward a small-ceiling refutation.
